purpose: A composition documents only the semantic delta introduced by combining existing components: new relations, constraints, roles, bindings, operations, events, flows or policies.

topics.name: Composition Delta
topics.purpose: A composition documents only the semantic delta introduced by combining existing components: new relations, constraints, roles, bindings, operations, events, flows or policies.

semantics.reuse_rule: Existing canonical semantics are referenced, not duplicated.
semantics.delta_rule: Only semantics introduced by the composition are declared locally.
semantics.ownership_rule: Composition never transfers ownership of referenced semantics.
semantics.traceability_rule: Resolved semantics retain original identity, owner and component provenance.
semantics.closure_rule: Recursive composition is deterministic and bounded by visited identities.
semantics.ordering_rule: Array/file order has no semantic precedence unless explicitly declared.

invariants.rule: Composition reuses owned canonical semantics and documents only its explicit semantic delta.

hard_gates.condition: referenced semantics duplicated as new authoritative ownership
recursive closure depends on filesystem or incidental array order
